ema_crossover.description: Long when EMA20 crosses above EMA50; exit on cross below.

macd_momentum.description: Long when MACD crosses its signal above zero; exit on cross below.

rsi_mean_reversion.description: Long when RSI14 < 30 in a long-term uptrend (close > SMA200); exit RSI > 55.

bollinger_mean_reversion.description: Long below the lower 20/2 Bollinger band; exit at the middle band.

donchian_breakout.description: Long on a close above the prior 20-day high; exit below the prior 10-day low.

trend_following.description: Long when close > SMA200 and SMA50 > SMA200; exit when close < SMA200.

atr_breakout.description: Long when close exceeds previous close by 1.5 ATR; time exit after 10 days.

relative_strength_momentum.description: Long stocks in the top 20% of 120-day return (skip 5 days); exit below the median.

vwap_trend.description: Intraday: long on VWAP reclaim with volume; exit below VWAP; flat by 15:10.

opening_range_breakout.description: Intraday: long above the 30-min opening range high; exit below range low; flat by 15:10.

notes: Parameters are textbook defaults chosen before testing (no optimisation).
Universe = current NIFTY 50 constituents: survivorship bias inflates results.
Long-only; signals at close t executed at open t+1.
